_source: Golden conversation 5 (docs/plans/text-advisor/11-testing-rollout.md § Engine golden conversations). Model and vision responses are hand-written to the API shapes, not captured from the live API; the landing trip and the advisory come from tests/fixtures/feeds/ (the alert moved to the test day); the rules rows are made up in the shape scripts/advisor/import-rules.mjs writes.
description: Golden 5 (TA-A6): a Spanish-speaking angler end to end. The first message gets the Spanish welcome and the day's port answer in Spanish from the pre-router; a planning question in Spanish (the second Spanish message, so the stored language becomes es) calls get_conditions with the species and gets the advisory first, the season, the one ladder phrase and the NWS closer in Spanish; a photo is identified in Spanish with the Spanish look-alike cue and the rule; SÍ shares it and asks for the credit in Spanish; 'me llamo Lupe' stores the credit; a canary that could be a vermilion gets the Spanish cue pair; AYUDA gets the Spanish help. No English sentence reaches the angler.

turns.in: hola, ¿qué está picando en Morro Bay?

input.en: Morro Bay, Sat Oct 3: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY posted for today. No skipper reports from the last three days. The landing reports Example Star last Sun with bocaccio, copper rockfish and 8 lingcod; recent reported activity: Low. Today's forecast isn't in yet. Full picture: {{link:port:morro-bay}}
input.es: Morro Bay, sáb 3 oct: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY (aviso del NWS) para hoy. No hay reportes de capitanes de los últimos tres días. El muelle reporta al Example Star el dom pasado con bocaccio, rocote cobrizo y 8 lingcod; actividad reciente reportada: Low. El pronóstico de hoy todavía no llega. Todo el detalle: {{link:port:morro-bay}}
